items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1960-03-29
items.q: He said, Mac, let me go out again... So I picked the chicken for him.

ctx.x: What did you do on the railroad?

Well I was labor at first car to clean, coach and fire. Finally World War II came up and the man came down. They took the man I was working for and took him away and put him in service and then sent another man from North Carolina and he wanted to go on a fishing trip. So he found out I could cook. He found out I could cook but I went on a fishing trip. He had never eaten ten line fish before and I ten line fish. I fried fish and we went hard while over there. I made some donuts for him. He had never knew it. It…
You say you heard him sing though when?
